$comment: Documents a DELIBERATE divergence (#1376): test-e2e-deploy.yml's NEXTJS_REF (the Next.js ref every compat cell tests) currently differs from packages/kn-next/templates/app/package.json.hbs's next pin (the Next.js version the scaffold actually ships). tests/nextjs-credential-lockstep.test.ts fails if either real value drifts from what THIS file documents, so a future bump to either side must update this manifest in the same PR — a reviewed decision, never silent drift.
divergenceReason: Next 16.3.0 introduced a confirmed upstream regression (Turbopack + adapterPath + output:'standalone' -> ENOENT next-server.js.nft.json, vercel/next.js; see issue #1372), fixed upstream in 16.3.5 (the scaffold's pin as of this bump, #1386, live-repro-verified). That fix clears only the BUILD-time blocker on option (a) (bump the credential to the shipped pin) -- it does NOT by itself clear re-credentialing. re-INVESTIGATED 2026-09-27 (#1376): bumping NEXTJS_REF also requires re-auditing test/deploy-tests-manifest.knext.json's $knextQuarantines ledger -- a SEPARATE, mechanized, CI-BLOCKING guard (tests/deploy-manifest.test.ts, ADR-0007 graduation addendum SS c) that reds the moment the workflow's default NEXTJS_REF no longer matches an entry's stamped nextjsRef, unless that entry carries a 'reaudited' marker for the new ref. All 14 entries in that ledger are stamped nextjsRef: v16.2.0 today, each documenting SPECIFIC upstream evidence (e.g. 'first removal candidate: the first NEXTJS_REF containing vercel/next.js#95301') that only a fresh compat-suite dispatch against v16.3.5 can re-verify per entry -- confirmed by attempting the bump and watching tests/deploy-manifest.test.ts go red in CI (PR #1545, reverted after the finding). So the credentialed lane stays at v16.2.0: re-credentialing on the fixed version needs BOTH the upstream regression fixed (done, #1386) AND a real per-entry quarantine re-audit against v16.3.5 (not done -- needs live compat-suite dispatch evidence, tracked as a properly-scoped follow-up on #1376), not just a pin-value edit.
